[← Portfolio](portfolio.ipynb)

The Change Planner Agent investigates a proposed code change before anyone edits
the repository. It searches a versioned snapshot, connects implementation evidence
to tests and history, forms regression hypotheses, and exports a plan that a human
can review.

## What it contains

The project separates repository indexing and retrieval from the LangGraph workflow.
The workflow plans an investigation, fans out research, retries failed steps,
verifies evidence, and supports pauses and resumes. A deterministic offline scenario
provides a repeatable way to inspect the default path.

Its evaluation compares lexical, dense, hybrid, structural, and workflow variants
on pinned repository fixtures. Reports include retrieval quality, estimated latency,
and index cost. A local repository can also be indexed and investigated without
changing its files.

## Explore the project

- [Source code, commands, and evaluation](https://github.com/particle1331/watchtower/tree/main/projects/change-planner)
- [LangGraph course](../courses/langgraph/index.ipynb)

The agent produces a reviewable plan. It does not edit code, merge changes, deploy
systems, or certify that a snapshot captures the complete production environment.
